name: Sunflowmon
main_effect: [When Digivolving] By suspending 1 of your green Digimon, you may play 1 Digimon card with [Vegetation], [Plant] or [Fairy] in any of its traits and 3000 DP or less from your hand without paying its play cost.
source_effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When an effect suspends one of your Digimon, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
